newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases as Algeria's Skikda reopens.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases as Algeria's Skikda reopens.

text.p: Northwest Europe naphtha prices eased slightly Friday after Algeria's Skikda port reopened for loadings after closing on Tuesday morning due to bad weather, traders said.
"Skikda is open again since this morning and is fully loading at the moment, and I'd see a little bit of a relaxed situation," said one trader.

Prompt physical cargoes were $2.00 weaker after Thursday's Bombay cargo trade at $229.00 cif NWE, but November swaps rose to converge with physical prices, gaining $2.00 to $222/$223. Some small Russian cargoes were still on offer, a trader said.
